###############################################################################
# DBSCAN Spatial Hotspot and Noise Extraction
###############################################################################
```{r}
library(dbscan)
library(factoextra)
library(ggplot2)
```


```{r}
# Generate synthetic spatial coordinate observations
set.seed(42)
n_core_pts <- 300
cluster1 <- data.frame(x = rnorm(n_core_pts/2, mean = 2, sd = 0.3), y = rnorm(n_core_pts/2, mean = 2, sd = 0.3))
cluster2 <- data.frame(x = rnorm(n_core_pts/2, mean = 6, sd = 0.5), y = rnorm(n_core_pts/2, mean = 5, sd = 0.4))
spatial_noise <- data.frame(x = runif(40, 0, 8), y = runif(40, 0, 8))

spatial_df <- rbind(cluster1, cluster2, spatial_noise)
```


```{r}
# 1. Determine Optimal Epsilon using 4-NN Distance Knee Plot
minPts_val <- 4
kNNdistplot(spatial_df, k = minPts_val)
abline(h = 0.45, col = "red", lty = 2)
```

```{r}
# 2. Fit DBSCAN Algorithm
# Very simple to run DBSCAN
db_res <- dbscan(spatial_df, eps = 0.45, minPts = minPts_val)
print(db_res)
# Cluster 0 is the noise cluster - points that don't fit in the actual datasets
```
```{r}
# 3. Analyze Noise Points vs. Cluster 
# want it to be treated  as a number as opposed to a factor 
spatial_df$cluster <- as.factor(db_res$cluster)
cat("Extracted Spatial Clusters:", max(db_res$cluster), "\n")
cat("Isolated Spatial Noise Points:", sum(db_res$cluster == 0), "\n")
```

```{r}
# 4. Visualize DBSCAN Results
fviz_cluster(
  db_res, 
  data = spatial_df[, c("x", "y")],
  stand = FALSE,
  ellipse = FALSE,
  show.clust.cent = FALSE,
  geom = "point",
  palette = "jco",
  ggtheme = theme_bw(),
  main = "DBSCAN Spatial Hotspots and Outlier Isolation")
```
